name: EQeS benchmark data
description: Dataset underlying the study Accuracy-Cost Trade-offs for Reference VQE Calculations of H₂ on IBM Quantum Hardware. It contains results from VQE calculations of molecular hydrogen performed on IBM quantum hardware between August 2025 and March 2026. The data cover different IBM quantum processors, fermion-to-qubit mappings, shot counts, resilience levels and execution modes, together with accuracy and computational-cost metrics. The dataset is provided as a curated snapshot of the data supporting the corresponding publication. An interactive and continuously evolving interface to EQeS benchmark data is available at https://quantum.larrucea.eu/molqbench/.
